title.en: Fable 25 — The Wolf in Sheep's Clothing

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A wolf wanted to get into the flock.

sentences.ar: הוא מצא עור של כבשה ולבש אותו.
sentences.en: He found a sheepskin and put it on.

sentences.ar: הרועה לא ראה אותו והוא נכנס.
sentences.en: The shepherd did not see him and he got in.
At night the shepherd looked for meat for a meal.
The lie worked right to the end.
